action_description: Replaced the parent stage-2 E_local-wide grouped-down schedule with a compact active-expert schedule. A single small CUDA metadata kernel now builds active_experts, compact active_offsets/active_counts, grouped_slots, token_counts, and active_expert_count from valid local T*top_k slots; the grouped GEMM2/finalize kernel launches over active_expert_count while preserving the parent GEMM1 and GEMM2 arithmetic. The parent full-E_local metadata path remains only as a validation fallback.
